title: Welcome to my dogfight simulator called project Wild Weasel
author: JudgeTall7532
selftext:
So its been an year I had been making a dogfight sim like DCS but haven't got too far then I started using Claude and now I can finally say that its playable now and its actually good with somewhat feels like Falcon 4.0 and real Caucasus terrain like DCS with nice detailed and functional jets with working cockpit.

You can see a gameplay video here -   
And the jets are F16, F15, F18 and A10.   
My personal favourite are F16 and A10. They are superb flying machines and of course I did use AI for a decent amount of time for past 2 months and I am surprised by its capabilities. 

Here is the download link and its completely free. Don't get irritated that it was chargeable and then it became free, actually the license key distribution works only on the paid games on [itch.io](http://itch.io) so that is little clumsy...   
[https://kevinpandya953.itch.io/project-wild-weasel](https://kevinpandya953.itch.io/project-wild-weasel)

comments.author: thetampa2
comments.body: Why would you use the name for a SEAD squadron for a dogfight game? Not sure how those two connect

replies.author: JudgeTall7532
replies.body: When the game was initially developed, I wanted to make it only for F16 and its insane sead capabilities as I basically started for a fun challange project. But then as I kept going forward the name stayed the same and the game's capabilities grew. And to be frank the SEAD mode in this game is a little difficult.
